# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-08-14

Zed launched Delta, a standalone CRDT-versioned multiplayer environment for human-agent coding that connects to Claude Code and is in private beta.

Went through 23 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. Zed: Introducing Delta
   Directly targets the multi-agent audit-trail gap that Git leaves open, and integrates with Claude Code rather than requiring a new agent.

2. I went looking for the studies behind "multi-model AI is more accurate". Three of them argue the opposite.
   Directly contradicts a widely repeated architectural assumption and can prevent building an ensemble layer that does not pay for itself.

3. ChatGPT Desktop (Codex Desktop) for Linux
   First-party Codex support on Linux changes where a solo dev can run their coding agent.

4. Neon skills landed in the Vercel CLI
   Establishes the package/integration manager as a distribution channel for agent skills — a structural change in how agent context reaches a repo.

5. Flutter 3.47
   A genuine breaking-change window (platform minimums, UIScene, Intel Mac) with a dated deadline attached to Xcode 27.
